fields.label: NIF
fields.description: Numéro d'Identification Fiscale — 15-digit tax identification number assigned by the Algerian tax authority. Legally required on all invoices per Article 11 of the Commercial Code.

fields.label: NIS
fields.description: Numéro d'Identification Statistique — statistical identification number assigned by the National Office of Statistics (ONS). Required on official documents.

fields.label: RC
fields.description: Registre de Commerce — commercial register number. Required for businesses with commercial activity.

fields.label: Capital Social
fields.description: Share capital (Capital Social) — the company's subscribed share capital in DZD. Relevant for SARL, EURL, and SPA company types; optional for sole proprietors.

fields.label: CNAS Employer Article Number
fields.description: CNAS employer affiliation article number — the company's own CNAS registration reference (not the individual employee numbers). Legally required on all invoices per Article 11 of the Commercial Code.
